business_scope.primary_industry_name: Zinc Alloy Die-Casting and Tampo Printing of 1:18 Scale Car Replicas

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Bermuda (British Overseas Territory; Exempted Limited Partnership regime)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English common-law heritage; Judicial Committee of the Privy Council as final appellate court)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: UK-Bermuda Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA), signed 29 November 2007, in force 21 July 2009
United States-Bermuda Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA), signed 2 July 1986, as amended by the 20 December 2001 and 15 May 2009 protocols

OECD/Council of Europe Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters, extended to Bermuda effective 1 January 2014, together with the CRS Multilateral Competent Authority Agreement
Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards (New York Convention 1958), extended to Bermuda by the United Kingdom
Hague Convention of 5 October 1961 Abolishing the Requirement of Legalisation for Foreign Public Documents (Apostille Convention), in force for the United Kingdom and extended to Bermuda

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Bermuda Monetary Authority Act 1969 (as amended); Proceeds of Crime Act 1997 (as amended); Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2008 (as amended); Anti-Terrorism (Financial and Other Measures) Act 2004 (as amended); Financial Intelligence Agency Act 2007; Exempted Partnerships Act 1992 (as amended) including beneficial-ownership record-keeping and filing duties applicable to exempted partnerships; Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Amendment Act 2018 and Companies (Register of Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2018, as extended; Economic Substance (Companies and Limited Partnerships) Amendment Act 2018; Notaries Public Act 1975.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Compliance of the corporate general partner (or its ultimate parent entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies House (United Kingdom) or equivalent registry in the foreign partner's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (or the relevant competent authority of the issuing state), then presented to the Bermuda Registrar of Companies or Bermuda counsel; consular legalization reserved for non-Hague destinations

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly certified extract of the board resolution of the corporate general partner authorizing the formation of the Bermuda Exempted Limited Partnership and the appointment of the Bermuda resident registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate General Partner; notarized by a Notary Public in the jurisdiction of the partner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille; consular legalization if the counterparty or destination authority is located in a non-Hague state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of ultimate beneficial owner passports and proof-of-address (utility bill or recent bank statement) for each natural-person UBO holding 25% or more of the partnership
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or licensed professional in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization; Hague Apostille applied only where the document must be produced to a foreign public authority; otherwise accepted by Bermuda AML/CFT obliged entities on a notarized-certified basis

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference / professional reference letter and source-of-funds and source-of-wealth memorandum for the UBO and the proposed ELP bank (Swift Wire and PayPal settlement onboarding)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating licensed bank, regulated financial institution, or regulated professional advisor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Direct written verification to the Bermuda CSP and receiving bank; notarization normally not required, but apostille or consular legalization is obtained where the destination institution requires recognition of foreign public documents

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all partners, UBOs, general-partner directors, officers, and authorized signatories against: (i) the UN Security Council Consolidated List; (ii) the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List; (iii) the UK Consolidated List of Financial Sanctions Targets (OFSI), including measures extended to Bermuda under the UK Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018; (iv) the Bermuda Monetary Authority regulatory and enforcement notifications; and (v) commercial PEP and adverse-media databases (World-Check / Refinitiv / Dow Jones). Screenings must be completed pre-incorporation, repeated at each admission of a new partner, and refreshed at least annually. Any positive PEP, sanctions, or adverse-media hit automatically suspends the formation until enhanced due diligence is completed, including independent source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification; concurrent reportable suspicions are filed with the Bermuda Financial Intelligence Agency under the Proceeds of Crime Act 1997.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registrar of Companies - Registry of Companies Online Entity Search and Name Reservation (Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda; https://www.gov.bm)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All statutory filings are made in English in Latin script. A non-Latin name must be transliterated into romanized English and should be accompanied by a certified transliteration certificate at the Registrar's request. The legal name of an Exempted Limited Partnership must conclude with an obligatory statutory suffix: 'Limited Partnership', 'L.P.', or 'LP'. Terminal corporate identifiers such as 'Ltd', 'LLC', 'PLC', 'Corp.', or 'Inc.' are not permitted for an ELP. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to a name already on the Bermuda register (including exempted companies, local companies, foreign companies, and other partnerships) and must not misrepresent the entity's legal form or imply any regulated or state-sponsored status.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Exempted Limited Partnerships Act 2015, as amended, ss. 4-9 (registration, certificate, name), ss. 13-18 (general and limited partners, liabilities), ss. 21-25 (registered office, records, filings); Limited Partnerships Act 1883 (transitional application); Companies Act 1981 (for the corporate general partner); Economic Substance Act 2018, ss. 3-8 and Schedule, if applicable; Trade and Business Licensing Act 1960 (industrial licensing).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (Registry of Companies, Ministry of Finance), 4th Floor, Government Administration Building, 30 Parliament Street, Hamilton HM 12, Bermuda
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of an Exempted Limited Partnership (Form ELP-1), together with the executed Exempted Limited Partnership Agreement, Declaration of General Partner (Form ELP-2), and Consent to Act of Registered Office and Registered Agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow deposit requirement for a Bermuda exempted limited partnership; capital contributions are contractually fixed in the limited partnership agreement and may be made in cash, promissory notes, property, or services, subject to AML/KYC verification.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: IT IS RESOLVED, as the first resolutions of the sole general partner of the Bermuda exempted limited partnership, that: (1) the capital contributions, profit and loss-sharing ratios, and governance terms set out in the executed exempted limited partnership agreement are adopted; (2) [Registered Office Provider], at [address] in Bermuda, is approved as the registered office and registered agent, and is instructed to file the registration application with the Registrar of Companies; (3) [Name / Title] is appointed as initial authorized officer, with authority to execute banking, tax, and operational documents; and (4) the general partner is authorized to sign all ancillary statutory forms and declarations required for registration and corporate governance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda (via licensed corporate services provider)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Run a name search for the proposed exempted limited partnership name, ensure no conflicting names under the Exempted Limited Partnerships Act 2015 and Companies Act 1981, confirm the corporate general partner's status, and reserve the name in writing with the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Proposed ELP name and alternative name
Certificate of incorporation and good standing of the corporate general partner
Authorizing resolution of the general partner's board
Completed due diligence/KYC forms for the general partner and beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar rejects the name as confusing or offensive, file a revised name reservation and restart the clearance procedure; appeal in writing to the Registrar under the Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Execute the Exempted Limited Partnership Agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Formation counsel and licensed registered office provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the partnership agreement with capital contributions, profit sharing, management powers, transfer restrictions, termination, and indemnification; have the general partner and all limited partners execute; notarize if required by banking or AML reviewers.
required_dossiers: General Partner Consent / First Board Resolution
Power of attorney and specimen signatures
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Re-execute the corrected agreement; if solicitors object, revise restricted provisions before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage Registered Office and Registered Agent in Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain a formal consent to act as registered office and registered agent from an approved Bermuda service provider, and ensure the registered office address is a physical street address in Bermuda, not a P.O. Box.
required_dossiers: Consent to Act as Registered Office and Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Substitute another licensed provider and obtain new consent before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda (Registry of Companies)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the completed registration application form together with the executed partnership agreement, general partner declaration, consent to act, and statutory fee; file either in person at the Registry counter or through the approved online corporate service provider; preserve stamped receipt for the Certificate of Registration.
required_dossiers: Form ELP-1 (Application for Registration of an Exempted Limited Partnership)
Consent to Act of Registered Office and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the Registrar's query by filing an amended form or supplementary statutory declaration within 14 calendar days; request priority correction or amend on the Registry's online interface.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Certificate of Registration and Post-Registration Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After approval, collect or receive the Certificate of Registration as an Exempted Limited Partnership; maintain the register of partners at the registered office, open statutory ledgers, issue partnership interest statements, and record the initial general partner and limited partners.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Registration as an Exempted Limited Partnership
Statutory books and corporate seal (if adopted)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Apply to the Registrar for rectification of the certificate or duplicate certificate if errors are discovered; re-file corrected particulars.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Regulatory, Tax, AML and Economic Substance Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority (for AML/ATF), Office of the Tax Commissioner, Bermuda Customs, and Registrar of Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Determine whether the die-casting business is in scope for Bermuda economic substance requirements; register with the Bermuda Tax Commissioner for payroll tax purposes; complete Bermuda Customs import registrations for industrial machinery; submit BMA AML/ATF notifications if the partnership carries on relevant financial activity; file the economic substance declaration with the Registrar if applicable.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Regularize with the Bermuda Tax Commissioner or Customs within statutory deadlines; if economic substance returns are queried, provide supplementary information to the Registrar.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Bermuda Trade and Business Licensing Office, Department of Business Development, Ministry of Economy and Labour
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Bermuda Trade Licence (Business Licence) for Industrial Manufacturing, together with a Metal Foundry / Die-Casting Operating Permit and a Discharge Permit issued by the Bermuda Department of Environment and Natural Resources

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Bermuda Department of Environment and Natural Resources, Ministry of Home Affairs, in consultation with the Bermuda Department of Planning
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - Full EIA Report likely required for a zinc alloy die-casting and tampo-printing facility with metal melting furnaces, VOC emissions and trade effluent; a Preliminary Environmental Review may be accepted if production scale, furnace capacity and emissions are de minimis.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater and trade effluent must comply with the general quality limits under Bermuda water protection rules, including pH 6-9, suspended solids below 50 mg/L, BOD below 30 mg/L, total zinc below 5 mg/L, and copper below 3 mg/L; VOC emissions from tampo printing must be controlled using enclosed operations, carbon adsorption or thermal oxidation; hazardous waste, spent solvents and die-casting dross must be stored in sealed, labeled containers and removed by a licensed waste carrier; emissions must not cause atmospheric nuisance or exceed Bermudian ambient air quality screening levels for particulates and lead.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service; structural load approval and building compliance certificate from the Bermuda Department of Planning; workplace clearance under the Bermuda Health and Safety at Work Act, including emergency egress, molten-metal hazard assessments, machine guarding, ventilation, eyewash stations, and certified electrical installation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Office of the Tax Commissioner (OTC), Bermuda Ministry of Finance - responsible for payroll tax, stamp duty, land tax, and the Bermuda Corporate Income Tax (CIT) under the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023. Bermuda Customs Department (Ministry of Finance) administers customs import and export duties. The Registrar of Companies (Ministry of Finance) administers registration of Exempted Limited Partnerships, business licences, beneficial ownership, and economic substance filings. Digital access: Bermuda Government eServices at www.gov.bm (OTC e-filing and Taxpayer Self-Service portal; Registrar e-Registry; Customs electronic entry clearance). The UK HMRC does not administer Bermuda taxes; UK income tax may separately apply to UK-resident partners of the ELP.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermuda dollar (BMD) is pegged to the US dollar at 1:1 and is freely convertible. Because all partners are non-Bermudian, the Exempted Limited Partnership is designated 'non-resident' for exchange control purposes under the Exchange Control Regulations 1973 and may hold multicurrency foreign-currency operational accounts (USD, EUR, GBP) and remit partner drawings/profits without BMA consent. Bermuda imposes no withholding tax or profit-remittance levy on distributions to non-resident partners; the only ongoing screens are the Economic Substance Declaration under the Economic Substance Act 2018, annual CRS/FATCA reporting of partners, and Beneficial Ownership filing.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Bermuda maintains no statutory export-proceeds surrender obligation, mandatory conversion ratio, or repatriation timeline; non-resident exempted entities may retain 100% of export receipts in the currency of invoice indefinitely, subject only to bank record-keeping and AML source-of-funds verification.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-Currency Operational Account (USD/EUR/GBP) with segregated Capital Escrow sub-ledger
US Dollar Operational Account plus GBP/USD treasury sweep
USD Operational Account with trade-facility limit

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MEDIUM-HIGH for UK-regulated EMI licences (Wise Business, Revolut Business, Currenxie, Airwallex) where the ELP can evidence a UK registered office, UK parent counterparty guarantee and an exempted-partnership certificate; LOW-POOR for non-bank offshore-only EMIs, which generally reject Bermuda pass-through entities because of beneficiary-owner transparency rules under the Beneficial Ownership Act 2019 and lack of a correspondent UK clearing relationship. PayPal is available for e-commerce settlement but must be routed through a UK PayPal Business Account for EMI-grade compliance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Hybrid mandate: Bermuda licensed banks require physical signatory verification of the General Partner or its authorised representative at a bank office (Hamilton, or an international branch/representative office in New York, London or Hong Kong), accompanied by certified copies of the Certificate of Limited Partnership, exempted partnership registration, partnership agreement, register of partners and GP board resolution. Fully remote opening is granted only if the UK parent holds a senior relationship with the same banking group, the partnership deed is notarised, a recorded live video interview is conducted, and a BMA-lodged 'non-resident' declaration is produced.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore limited-partnership opacity: multiple LPs, nominee/escrow ownership, or inability to identify the beneficiary of trading profit
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Certificate of Limited Partnership and Exempted Partnerships Act 2009 registration; full partnership agreement; register of limited partners with UBO declarations; registered-agent certificate of incumbency; non-resident status declaration signed by the General Partner; and a written commercial rationale confirming that the ELP intermediates the UK-owned die-cast model manufacturing and sales business.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-haven/EU tax-list legacy red flags and CRS/FATCA reporting gaps on offshore pass-through structures
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: BMA Economic Substance Declaration confirming non-captive goods-trading activity; CRS-1/FATCA self-certification per partner; Beneficial Ownership (Companies and Limited Partnerships) Act 2019 filing receipt; UK parent audited financial statements and group structure chart; and evidence of real activity (management accounts, third-party die-casting purchase contracts, sales invoices for 1:18-scale automotive replicas).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-finance cash-flow mismatch: inbound equity capital against high-frequency PayPal retail receipts and outbound wires to East-Asian casting foundries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Per-transaction trade file: purchase order, proforma invoice, bill of lading/airway bill, inspection certificate; monthly reconciliation of PayPal settlement against SKU-level sales records; sanctions/PEP screening of all suppliers and buyers; and AML policy memorandum confirming that supplier wires are not co-mingled with partner distributions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: UK parent converts GBP to USD and sends an SWIFT MT103 credit to the Bermuda ELP USD operational account with remittance details 'ELP Capital Contribution – Account [No.], Non-Resident Exempted Limited Partnership' and BOP purpose code EQ (equity capital) under UK BoP reporting. BMA exchange-control approval is waived because both sender and beneficiary are non-resident; the receiving bank must nevertheless hold a GP board resolution, updated register of partners, and source-of-funds declaration for any transfer exceeding USD 500,000.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: SWIFT MT103 with value date and purpose code CG (general goods) for routine supplier payments; irrevocable Commercial Letters of Credit (ICC UCP600, sight or 90-day) issued via MT700 through the senior clearing bank for die-casting tooling and bulk zinc-alloy purchase orders above USD 100,000; PayPal Business settlements swept from the UK PayPal balance to the ELP via the partner bank's currency conversion service; USD/GBP conversion executed on the bank's FX electronic platform with same-day CHAPS over the UK leg.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX Forwards (GBP/USD, tenors 1-12 months) under an ISDA-style master confirmation with the senior bank
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDF) on USD/CNY for supplier-currency exposure to Chinese die-casting foundries not holding BMD liquidity
Cross-Currency Swaps (GBP/USD floating-vs-fixed) matching UK parent equity injections to USD operating cash flows
Vanilla FX Options (GBP/USD put/call) for export-price stabilisation of 1:18-scale model sales to North American and European distributors

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance, Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January of each calendar year, covering the immediately preceding calendar year; the filing date is fixed and does not follow the registration anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory penalty of BMD 200 per month (maximum BMD 1,000) plus the unpaid annual fee; the Registrar may administratively strike off the ELP after approximately three months of arrears; strike-off does not discharge the general partner's liabilities; restoration requires a court application and reinstatement fees

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Return or Non-Residence Notification (annual filing confirming Bermuda tax non-residence or economic substance compliance)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies (Economic Substance Office), Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the ELP's financial year-end; for a 31 December year-end, filing is due by 30 June of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed penalty of BMD 10,000 for failure to file; additional BMD 50,000 for continuing default; aggregate exposure up to BMD 250,000; the general partner may be personally liable; repeated default can lead to court-ordered strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is imposed on a Bermuda exempted partnership. An audit becomes contractually or regulatorily mandatory when (i) the limited partnership agreement or an investor side letter requires it (common triggers: gross assets above USD 5,000,000 or annual revenue above USD 10,000,000), (ii) the Registrar requests audited financial statements in support of an Economic Substance Return submission, or (iii) the UK ultimate parent must consolidate the ELP under UK-adopted IFRS and the group auditor requires audit evidence on the subsidiary
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Bermuda has no domestic codified GAAP; the ELP must maintain full and proper books reflecting a true and fair view, with IFRS or US GAAP as the acceptable frameworks; IFRS is the market standard for a UK-parented pass-through ELP

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Bermuda does not operate a public UBO register for exempted partnerships. The ELP must keep a confidential Register of Beneficial Owners at its registered office; the general partner must identify and verify each individual who controls 25% or more of the partnership interests or otherwise controls the general partner. Any transfer of a limited partnership interest must be reflected in the register within 14 days of the general partner becoming aware; the register is confirmed by the general partner annually at the time of signing the Annual Declaration and, if an Economic Substance Return is due, the same beneficial ownership data is delivered to the Registrar. Contraventions attract a fine of up to BMD 10,000.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Contributions and Capital Accounts
Register of Charges (where secured debt exists)
Minute Book of General Partner and Investment Committee resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 3,000 – USD 6,000 per annum (registered office plus licensed resident partnership agent / corporate secretary)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory audit is required; where contractually triggered, a licensed Bermuda C.P.A. firm typically charges USD 10,000 – USD 25,000 for an IFRS/US-GAAP audit of a single-asset pass-through ELP

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% flat rate imposed by Bermuda's Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 (CITA 2023), effective for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2025; no progressive bands, surtax, or branch tax apply.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The Exempted Limited Partnership (ELP) is fiscally transparent, so no Bermudian corporate income tax crystallises at the partnership level; only in-scope partners are taxed at 15% on their allocable share. Material reliefs reduce the effective rate: (i) the OECD Pillar Two Substance-Based Income Exclusion (SBIE) for eligible payroll and tangible assets used in die-casting and tampo-printing, transitioning from 10%/8% to a permanent 5%/5% carve-out; (ii) recognition of Qualified Refundable Tax Credits and Qualified Imputed Credits under the GloBE rules; (iii) foreign tax credit relief for UK corporation tax, US federal tax, and other Covered Taxes borne by the partners on the same profits; and (iv) a de facto 0% cash effective rate where all non-resident partners are outside the EUR 750m MNE threshold. No investment tax credits, patent boxes, or manufacturing allowances exist in Bermuda.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: TAA Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Return (Form CIT-1) filed electronically through the Bermuda Tax Administration Agency (TAA) e-Filing Portal using the entity's Bermuda TIN and Registry registration ID.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing due date is 15 months after the end of the fiscal year (e.g., a 31 December 2025 year-end is due by 31 March 2027); the self-assessed CIT shown on the return is payable on the same due date. Registration as an in-scope entity must occur within 30 days after the entity becomes in scope.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity identification: Bermuda TIN, ELP Registry number, fiscal year-end, and legal form confirmation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident-owned ELP must enter its Bermuda TIN and may omit foreign TIN fields; the ELP must tick the 'fiscally transparent partnership' status box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reporting status election: flow-through partnership status and QDMTT constituent entity designation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select 'Pass-through ELP — no entity-level CIT' and attach Schedule PR-2 allocating taxable income to each non-resident partner.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net accounting profit before tax per the audited IFRS/GAAP financial statements of the zinc alloy die-casting and tampo-printing trade.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter zero at the ELP level for transparent treatment; file the partner allocation schedule referencing each partner's jurisdiction of tax residence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: GloBE adjustments: add-back of non-deductible expenses, inclusion of covered taxes, and computation of the Substance-Based Income Exclusion.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute adjustments only in the hands of in-scope partners; the shares allocated to out-of-scope non-resident investors are excluded from the Bermuda jurisdictional ETR calculation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bermuda CIT and QDMTT due: 15% of adjusted taxable income less SBIE, foreign tax credits, QRTCs, and QICs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No payment is due when all partners are below the EUR 750m consolidated revenue threshold; a nil return must still be filed to preserve good standing with the TAA.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fixed penalty of BMD 10,000 plus BMD 100 per day of continued default; late payment: statutory interest at 2.5% per month or part month on unpaid tax, plus a 10% default surcharge when tax remains unpaid 6 months after the due date; fraudulent returns attract a civil penalty equal to 100% of the understated tax and referral for prosecution with fines up to BMD 50,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: GloBE Information Return (GIR) and Country-by-Country Report (CbCR) — OECD XML schema filed via the TAA e-Filing Portal or through a designated filing constituent entity in another jurisdiction; Bermuda local filing is required where the group's ultimate parent has not filed an accessible GIR.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The GIR is due within 15 months after the end of the reporting fiscal year, or 18 months for the first qualifying year; the QDMTT top-up schedule (Form CIT-1a) is due with the ordinary CIT-1 filing deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List of all constituent entities of the MNE group, jurisdiction of incorporation, TINs, and accounting classification of the transparent ELP.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report non-resident partners only when they are constituent entities of the group; otherwise the ELP reports itself as a flow-through entity with no covered taxes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bermuda jurisdictional effective tax rate: total adjusted covered taxes divided by GloBE income of the in-scope entities in Bermuda.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For the transparent ELP, the QDMTT is zero at entity level; include only in-scope partners' shares in the Bermuda jurisdictional pool.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Eligible payroll and tangible fixed assets of the die-cast manufacturing operations and the applicable carve-out multiplier.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a schedule of the ELP's Bermudian employees and plant assets; foreign-owned assets used outside Bermuda are excluded from the carve-out.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the GIR or CbCR: BMD 10,000 fixed penalty plus BMD 100 per day of continued default; deliberate non-filing can attract a civil penalty of the greater of BMD 50,000 or 10% of the group's Bermudian revenue, with the general partner personally liable for the default.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Bermuda imposes no withholding tax on dividends, partnership distributions, or capital gains realised by non-resident partners; CITA 2023 contains no dividend WHT provisions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Bermuda is not party to comprehensive double-tax agreements, so the treaty relief protocol is limited to: (i) applying to the TAA for a Tax Residency Certificate (Form TRC-1) with certified incorporation documents, a declaration of management and control in Bermuda, and evidence of economic substance; (ii) apostilling the TRC for presentation to the UK HMRC or US IRS, the residence states of the ELP's partners; and (iii) claiming foreign tax credit or repatriation relief in those residence states under their domestic law, not under a Bermuda treaty. Because Bermuda levies no withholding tax on outward distributions, no source-state treaty relief is required; the ELP should instead issue a fiscal transparency certificate confirming that tax is borne at the partner level.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Bermuda rates: 0% for IP royalties (including tampo-print artwork licences and brand royalties) and 0% for debt interest on shareholder loans or intercompany notes. There is no treaty rate override because no UK-Bermuda income tax treaty exists; the relevant cross-border controls are the UK CTA 2010 transfer-pricing rules, the diverted profits tax, and the GloBE interest limitation rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory OECD Master File, Local File, and CbCR/GIR arise when the MNE group has consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750 million (approximately BMD 750 million) in at least two of the four preceding fiscal years. For a trading ELP below that threshold, contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation is not statutorily mandatory, but CITA and TAA TP Guidelines require that controlled transactions - zinc alloy purchases, tampo-printing machinery, brand royalties, and management fees - satisfy the arm's-length standard; bank AML/KYC reviews and PayPal or SWIFT onboarding will also demand intercompany pricing evidence.
